translation: The bixin bone (蔽心骨) is the jiuwei bone (鳩尾骨). Its substance is a cartilaginous bone, located below the chest between the qigu bones (岐骨). When it is injured by falls, blows, and impacts, with unceasing pain, qi stringing through the two flanks, pain throughout the abdomen, the waist bent so one cannot straighten up, and both hands pressing the chest, one should administer Bafen San (Eight-Fen Powder, 八釐散) internally, wash externally with an Ai (mugwort) and vinegar decoction, apply Wanling Gao (Myriad-Efficacy Plaster, 萬靈膏), and when thirsty drink light yellow wine.
